name: KALIUM SILICICUM
key_symptoms: Absent-minded, anxious, indolent, timid. Feeble will power. Head congested, blood surges from body to head. Vertigo, coldness of head; photophobia. Nasal catarrh, discharge bloody, excoriating, offensive nose, swollen, ulcerated.
Gastric.--Weight in stomach after eating, nausea, pain, flatulence. Pain in liver region. Constipation. Construction of anus during stool.
Stiffness over body and limbs. Creeping sensation over limbs. Twitching of muscles. Weak and weary.
